svg.title: NET-03-E — Bound player-hosted selection and conditional Direct setup
svg.desc: Existing shared player-hosted allocation. The protected browser-selected example shows read-only Address and Port, selected hosting/origin/session context, masked Password with initial focus, two local setup panels, contextual feedback, and fixed Connect/Back. No password selection keeps Password optional and initially focuses local setup. Only independent Direct setup makes endpoint fields editable and initially focuses Address. Geometry and keylines remain unchanged.

g.text: Local players: 1 • Session-only scores • Optional scripts disabled
Round 1 in progress. You will play immediately if admitted.
The host confirms availability when you connect.
Selected: flat read-only endpoint, no input targets; traverse Password → local setup → Connect → Back.
No password: optional field, local focus. Direct only: editable endpoint, Address focus; supported type row.
Correction retains binding. Back → NET-10 → Direct unlocks target. No PKI claim; connecting stays NET-03.
